# Halcyon Threshold — Emberfall Fund Rapid Grant Proposal

**Applicant:** Morgan Hale (independent)
**Project:** Halcyon Threshold
**Requested amount:** $10,000
**Duration:** 6 months (Dec 2026 – May 2027)

---

## What we'll do

Halcyon Threshold is an independent project working to improve the outcome of superintelligent AI. With this grant, I will run three concrete workstreams in parallel:

**1. A small-grants program for neglected AI safety work ($5,000 re-granted)**
Most funding goes to large labs and established organizations. I will award 4–6 micro-grants of $500–$1,500 to individuals working on neglected corners of AI safety: interpretability tooling for small models, governance research outside DC, evals for capabilities nobody is measuring.
